# Byte downloads
`serve(data, range_header=None)` returns `(status, headers, body)` where data
is bytes and headers include `Content-Length`. No range returns 200 and full
data. One `bytes=start-end` range has an inclusive end; an omitted end means
EOF. `bytes=-N` means the last N bytes. Clamp an end past EOF. A range with
start beyond EOF, zero suffix, reverse bounds, or bad syntax returns 416,
empty body, and `Content-Range: bytes */<length>`. A successful range
returns 206 and `Content-Range: bytes <start>-<end>/<length>`.
The header must exactly match one of `bytes=D-D`, `bytes=D-`, or `bytes=-D`,
where each D is one or more ASCII digits 0 through 9. Leading zeros are allowed.
No whitespace (including trailing newlines), signs on numbers, underscores,
Unicode digits, extra separators, or multiple ranges are allowed. Both endpoints
cannot be omitted. Every range on empty data returns 416.
files.download/ranges.py:
import re

_DIGITS = r'[0-9]+'
# Exactly one of: bytes=D-D, bytes=D-, or bytes=-D, where each D is one or
# more ASCII digits (0-9) with optional leading zeros. Nothing else is
# allowed: no whitespace, signs, underscores, Unicode digits, extra
# separators, multiple ranges, or both endpoints omitted.
_GRAMMAR = rf'bytes=(?:{_DIGITS}-{_DIGITS}|{_DIGITS}-|-{_DIGITS})'


def parse_range(header, length):
    """Validate a single-range header against data of ``length`` bytes.

    Returns an inclusive ``(start, end)`` pair, or ``None`` when the header
    has bad syntax or the range is unsatisfiable (start beyond EOF, zero
    suffix, reverse bounds, or any range on empty data), in which case the
    caller must answer with 416.
    """
    if not isinstance(header, str) or not re.fullmatch(_GRAMMAR, header):
        return None
    spec = header[6:]
    if spec.startswith('-'):
        # Suffix: the last N bytes. Zero suffix or empty data is unsatisfiable.
        count = int(spec[1:])
        if length == 0 or count == 0:
            return None
        return max(length - count, 0), length - 1
    start_str, end_str = spec.split('-', 1)
    start = int(start_str)
    if length == 0 or start >= length:
        return None
    if end_str == '':
        # No end: run to EOF.
        return start, length - 1
    end = int(end_str)
    if end >= length:
        end = length - 1  # clamp an end past EOF
    if end < start:  # reverse bounds
        return None
    return start, end

import sys
from download.service import serve

if __name__ == '__main__':
    status, headers, body = serve(sys.stdin.buffer.read(), sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else None)
    print(status, headers, body)
